semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Sinom Corporation provides mass flow meters and controllers that are applicable in various semiconductor-related processes such as CVD and PVD vacuum coating.
summary: Sinom Corporation specializes in manufacturing mass flow meters and controllers that are utilized in semiconductor applications, particularly in processes requiring precise gas flow control. Their products are designed for a wide range of applications including gas filling, mixing, and flow measurement in laboratory instruments.
capabilities: Mass flow meters/controllers for gas flow control
High accuracy measurement systems for laboratory instruments
Low pressure drop flow measurement solutions
